name: 28785 · Waynesville, NC
findings: ZIP 28785 (Waynesville) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28785 (Waynesville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28785 (Waynesville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
